text.p: These are the main stories reported in the Angolan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Angola's former Unita leader Jonas Savimbi has been invited to attend a meeting of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) in Luanda on Wednesday. The invitation was delivered by a Zambian delegation on Saturday.
- South African President Nelson Mandela arrives in Luanda on Tuesday to participate in the meeting of the SADC, South Africa's foreign ministry said.
- Eighteen agricultural projects costing about 18 million dollars have been earmarked for development in Angola's eastern Moxico province, an agricultural ministry official said.
- Portugal's chief of staff, General Cerqueira Rocha visited the barracks of Angolan Armed Forces commanders at Cabo Ledo, south of Luanda, over the weekend.
